info.title: ACAP Event Engine
info.description:
REST API for the Axis Event Engine ACAP — an If-This-Then-That style rule engine running on Axis cameras.

All endpoints are served via FastCGI at `/local/acap_event_engine/{endpoint}` and require HTTP Basic Auth with admin credentials.

### Template Variables
Action strings (URLs, payloads, messages, overlay text, etc.) support `{{...}}` substitution:

| Variable | Value |
|----------|-------|
| `{{timestamp}}` | RFC 3339 timestamp in device local time (e.g. `2026-04-30T13:00:00+02:00`) |
| `{{date}}` | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `{{time}}` | HH:MM:SS |
| `{{camera.serial}}` | Device serial number |
| `{{camera.model}}` | Device model name |
| `{{camera.ip}}` | Device IP address |
| `{{trigger_json}}` | Full trigger event data as compact JSON |
| `{{trigger.KEY}}` | Individual field from the trigger event |
| `{{var.NAME}}` | Named variable value |
| `{{counter.NAME}}` | Named counter value |
| `{{gps.latitude}}`, `{{gps.longitude}}` | Latest coordinates from a fresh GPS fix |
| `{{gps.speed_kmh}}`, `{{gps.speed_mph}}`, `{{gps.speed_knots}}`, `{{gps.speed_mps}}` | Latest speed in the named units |
| `{{gps.heading}}`, `{{gps.heading_cardinal}}`, `{{gps.altitude_m}}` | Heading, compass direction, and altitude |
| `{{gps.age}}` | Seconds since the latest valid fix |
| `{{trigger.snapshot_base64}}` | Base64 JPEG (when `attach_snapshot` is true on HTTP Request, Email, MQTT Publish, Slack, Teams, or Telegram actions) |

Numeric formatting: `{{trigger.KEY|N}}` rounds a numeric field to N decimal places — e.g. `{{trigger.Temperature|2}}` → `20.35`. GPS values other than age resolve to `--` unless GPS is enabled and a fresh fix is available.

camera_ip.description: IP address of the Axis camera

trigger_logic.description: How multiple triggers are combined. AND = all triggers must fire within trigger_window seconds. AND_ACTIVE = all triggers must be in their active state simultaneously.

trigger_window.description: AND correlation window in seconds. When trigger_logic is AND, all triggers must fire within this period. 0 = no time limit (all must fire at least once).

cooldown.description: Minimum seconds between consecutive firings (0 = no cooldown)

max_executions.description: Max times rule can fire per period (0 = unlimited)

max_exec_period.description: Period for max_executions counter. Empty string means lifetime total.

allOf.description: Fires when any matching device event is received from the event system. Topics are specified using the multi-level ONVIF namespace format.

topic0.description: Top-level topic namespace → value pair, e.g. {"tns1": "VideoAnalytics"}

topic1.description: Second-level topic namespace → value pair, e.g. {"tnsaxis": "MotionDetection"}

filter_key.description: Optional: event data key to match for boolean filter (e.g. 'active')

value_key.description: Event data key for numeric threshold matching (e.g. 'CO2')

value_hold_secs.description: Condition must hold for this many seconds before firing (0 = fire immediately)

allOf.description: Fires when POST /fire is called with a matching token. Token can be passed as body.token or ?token= query parameter.

token.description: Secret token that must match the POST /fire request (max 120 characters)

cron.description: Cron expression (min hour dom mon dow). Used when schedule_type is 'cron'.

interval_seconds.description: Seconds between firings. Used when schedule_type is 'interval'.

time.description: Time of day in HH:MM format. Used when schedule_type is 'daily_time'.

days.description: Days of week (0=Sun, 1=Mon, …, 6=Sat). Used with daily_time.

event.description: Astronomical event. Used when schedule_type is 'astronomical'.

latitude.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (North positive). Used when schedule_type is 'astronomical'. Defaults to Location latitude.

longitude.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (East positive). Used when schedule_type is 'astronomical'. Defaults to Location longitude.

offset_minutes.description: Minutes to offset the astronomical event (positive = after, negative = before).

topic_filter.description: MQTT topic filter. Supports + (single-level) and # (multi-level) wildcards.

payload_filter.description: Optional substring that must appear in the payload for the trigger to fire.

allOf.description: Fires on a digital I/O input port state change.

hold_secs.description: Port must remain in the triggered state for this many seconds before firing (0 = fire immediately)

allOf.description: Fires when a named counter crosses a threshold value.

counter_name.description: Name of the counter to watch

value.description: Value the counter is compared against

op.description: Comparison operator (gte = ≥, gt = >, lte = ≤, lt = <, eq = =, ne = ≠)

allOf.description: Fires whenever another named rule executes successfully.

rule_id.description: ID of the rule whose firing triggers this rule

allOf.description: Polls one Modbus value or a register map (TCP, serial gateway, or RTU/RS-485). Supports typed integers, floats and strings, word order, scaling and threshold/change triggers.

connection_type.description: Transport: tcp=Modbus TCP, serial_gateway=RTU framing via PortManager GenericTCPServer, rtu=direct serial

host.description: TCP/serial_gateway: hostname or IP address of Modbus TCP device

register.description: Single-value register address (0-based); use map for multiple values

data_type.description: Single-value type; bit registers return 0 or 1

word_order.description: Byte order. All four apply to 32/64-bit values; for 16-bit values and strings only ABCD (normal) and BADC (bytes swapped in each register) differ

scale.description: Numeric decoded value = raw × scale + offset; cannot be zero

length.description: String length in registers (2 bytes each); text ends at the first NUL

variable.description: Optional variable updated by a single-value read

map.description: Read mapped values. One request covers up to 125 registers or 2000 bits; a larger map is read in several requests. A map spans at most 2000 registers or bits.

compare.description: Map variable used for threshold comparison; defaults to the first map entry

op.description: Comparison operator for threshold check. Omit to fire on the first read and on every change of value.

allOf.description: Fires when Modbus requests start failing and when the device recovers; optionally fires on every failed request.

device.description: Optional substring filter for the device address or serial path

fire_on.description: Fire on failure/recovery transitions, or on every failed request and on recovery

allOf.description: Fires when a Sparkplug host writes a metric to this edge node via NCMD or DCMD. Injects {{trigger.metric}} and {{trigger.value}}. Requires Sparkplug B to be enabled in Settings.

metric.description: Metric name written by the host. Omit to fire on any metric write.

value_filter.description: Fire only on an exact value match. Booleans arrive as 'true' or 'false'.

allOf.description: Fires when a fresh valid GPS fix arrives, rate-limited by interval_s.
Fires when speed enters the configured threshold. Hysteresis controls the reset boundary.

value2.description: Upper bound when op is between

allOf.description: Fires on entry/exit of a circle or polygon.
Fires when GPS fix is acquired, lost, or becomes stale.

Fires when an AXIS Object Analytics scenario becomes active (event topic CameraApplicationPlatform/ObjectAnalytics/Device1Scenario<N> with active=true). An inactive event fires nothing and stops a running siren_light started by the rule. Trigger data: scenario_id plus the event's data fields.

object_class.description: Optional filter: fire only when the event's reason field equals this value exactly (e.g. human). Empty or absent: any object.

allOf.description: No subscription and no configuration. The rule fires only when run explicitly: POST /fire with the rule id (conditions are checked; trigger data is the optional trigger_data object), or a run_rule action from another rule.
Only allow firing between two times of day.
Check the current state of a digital I/O port.
Compare a named counter against a threshold.
Compare a named variable against a value. Use variable 'system.armed' with value 'true'/'false' for arm/disarm patterns.

Compare a field of the event that fired the rule (any {{trigger.KEY}}). Numbers compare numerically, text compares as text; contains/not_contains ignore case. The value may contain templates such as {{var.NAME}}. Fails if the field is missing.
Make an HTTP request and pass only if the response matches. Supports status code check, body substring, and JSONPath value comparison.

expected_body.description: Substring that must appear in the response body

json_path.description: Dot-notation path into a JSON response body (e.g. 'data.temperature')

tls_profile.description: Name of a TLS profile (see /certs): private CA and/or client certificate for mutual TLS. Empty or absent: public CAs, no client certificate.

cert.description: Client certificate first, then its chain

expires.description: Earliest expiry (epoch seconds) of the client certificate and the CAs

allOf.description: Check the current state of a VAPIX event by querying the event instance list. Supports boolean match, numeric threshold, substring match, or exact string equality. When remote_host is set, queries a remote Axis device.

event_key.description: Partial topic string to match (e.g. tns1:Device/tnsaxis:IO/VirtualInput)

source_key.description: Optional source field identifying one instance of the event (e.g. port for virtual inputs and I/O ports). Without a source filter the condition passes when any instance matches.

op.description: Comparison operator. Omit or use eq_str for legacy exact-match behaviour.

expected.description: Expected value for boolean (true/false), contains (substring), or exact match modes

remote_host.description: IP or hostname of a remote Axis device

remote_https.description: Reach the remote device over HTTPS (required for OS 13 cameras that are HTTPS-only). The device's self-signed certificate is accepted.

allOf.description: Pass only during day or only during night, computed from sunrise and sunset at the given location. Day runs from sunrise + sunrise_offset_minutes until sunset + sunset_offset_minutes and may cross midnight; if the offsets make that window empty it is night all day. With no sunrise or sunset, midnight sun counts as day and polar night as night.

state.description: Required state. Any value other than day is treated as night.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees. When lat and lon are both 0 or absent, the engine location (settings engine.latitude/longitude) is used.

sunrise_offset_minutes.description: Shift sunrise by this many minutes (positive = later). Clamped to ±720.

sunset_offset_minutes.description: Shift sunset by this many minutes (positive = later). Clamped to ±720.

allOf.description: Query the current AXIS Object Analytics occupancy of a scenario (getOccupancy on /local/objectanalytics/control.cgi) and compare it with a threshold. Fails if scenario_id, op or value is missing, or the count is not available. When remote_host is set, queries a remote Axis device.

object_class.description: Key of the occupancy data to compare (e.g. human, car). Empty, absent or "any": the total count.

value.description: Threshold to compare the count against

remote_host.description: IP or hostname of a remote Axis device

remote_pass.description: Password for the remote device. Secret: replaced with __REDACTED__ in rule exports unless include_secrets=1.

remote_https.description: Reach the remote device over HTTPS (required for OS 13 cameras that are HTTPS-only). The device's self-signed certificate is accepted.

remote_host.description: IP address or hostname of a remote Axis device to execute this action on. When set, the action targets the remote device via VAPIX over HTTP using digest authentication. Supported by: recording, overlay_text, overlay_image, ptz_preset, io_output, io_flash, audio_clip, siren_light, guard_tour, set_device_param, ir_cut_filter, privacy_mask, wiper, light_control, acap_control, speaker_display, paging_console_execute, paging_console_button.

remote_user.description: Username for the remote device (default: root). Required when remote_host is set.

remote_pass.description: Password for the remote device user. Required when remote_host is set.

remote_https.description: Reach the remote device over HTTPS instead of HTTP. Required for OS 13 cameras that default to HTTPS-only. The device's self-signed certificate is accepted (no verification).

tls_profile.description: Name of a TLS profile (see /certs): private CA and/or client certificate for mutual TLS. Empty or absent: public CAs, no client certificate.

headers.description: HTTP headers, one per line in 'Key: Value' format

attach_snapshot.description: If true, fetches a JPEG snapshot from the camera and makes it available as {{trigger.snapshot_base64}}

attach_alpv_image.description: For AXIS License Plate Verifier events (carID): fetch the image ALPV saved for the car as {{trigger.alpv_image_base64}}. Waits up to 15 s for ALPV to save it without blocking other rules, then sends without it.

on_failure.description: Actions to execute if the HTTP request fails (non-2xx or network error)

attach_snapshot.description: If true, fetches a JPEG snapshot and exposes it as {{trigger.snapshot_base64}} for payload template expansion

allOf.description: Publishes declared metrics as a Sparkplug B NDATA (or DDATA when a device id is configured). Metric names must already exist in Settings -> Sparkplug B, otherwise they are absent from the birth certificate and are rejected.

name.description: Must match a metric declared in Settings

value.description: Template-aware; converted to the metric's declared datatype

duration.description: Max recording duration in seconds (0 = unlimited)

diskid.description: Storage disk ID to record to (e.g. SD_DISK). Use /axis-cgi/disks/list.cgi to list disks.

profile.description: Name of a stream profile configured on the camera (sent as streamprofile=NAME).

options.description: Raw VAPIX stream options, e.g. 'resolution=1920x1080&fps=15' or 'videocodec=h265'. Takes precedence over profile. On OS 13 the underlying continuous-recording API requires options; when profile and options are both empty, videocodec=h264 (native resolution) is used.

while_active.description: If true, stop recording automatically when the triggering event goes inactive

operation.description: 'set' shows or updates the overlay; 'clear' removes it (only text-free fields apply).

overlay.description: Optional overlay name. Actions with the same name, channel and target device control the same overlay, also across rules. Empty = the channel's shared overlay.

duration.description: Seconds to display before auto-removing (0 = leave until next update)

position.description: Overlay position. 'keep' leaves the current position unchanged; 'custom' uses pos_x/pos_y.

pos_x.description: Custom X coordinate (normalized -1..1, left to right). Used when position=custom.

pos_y.description: Custom Y coordinate (normalized -1..1, top to bottom). Used when position=custom.

font_size.description: Optional text size in pixels (the camera's range, usually 16-200, is reported by getOverlayCapabilities). Not sent when unset: the camera's default.

bg_color.description: Optional background colour behind the text. Not sent when unset.

outline_color.description: Optional outline colour around the letters. Not sent when unset.

operation.description: 'set' shows or updates the image overlay; 'clear' removes it.

overlay.description: Optional overlay name. Actions with the same name, channel and target device control the same image overlay, also across rules. Empty = the channel's shared image overlay.

image.description: Image uploaded to the camera (Video > Overlays): its full path as listed by the Dynamic Overlay API, or just the file name. Supports {{variable}} substitution.

duration.description: Seconds to display before auto-removing (0 = leave until the next update or Clear)

position.description: Overlay position. 'keep' leaves the current position unchanged; 'custom' uses pos_x/pos_y.

pos_x.description: Custom X coordinate (normalized -1..1, left to right). Used when position=custom.

pos_y.description: Custom Y coordinate (normalized -1..1, top to bottom). Used when position=custom.

ports.description: Ports to set in one request (ports turning off are switched first). Takes precedence over port/state.

port.description: Single-port form, used when ports is absent

state.description: Output state for the single-port form

duration.description: Seconds to hold the states, then return every port to its state from before the action (0 = hold until changed)

mode.description: sequence = one port at a time in list order; together = all ports at once

on_ms.description: On time per flash in milliseconds

off_ms.description: Off time between flashes in milliseconds. Default 0 for sequence, on_ms for together.

stop.description: When to stop: after count flashes, after duration seconds, or when the rule is disabled, edited or deleted

count.description: Flashes when stop = count. One flash = every listed port once.

while_active.description: Also stop when the triggering condition clears

clip_name.description: Name or ID of the audio clip to play

volume.description: Playback volume (0-100). Omit to use device default.

loop_count.description: Number of times to repeat. 0 = loop indefinitely until while_active stop. 1 = play once.

channel.description: Audio output channel. Omit to use device default.

while_active.description: If true and loop_count is 0, stop the clip automatically when the triggering condition clears

allOf.description: Start or stop a named siren/LED profile on supported devices (e.g. Axis D6310).

while_active.description: If true, stop the signal automatically when the triggering event goes inactive

allOf.description: Fetch the latest data from a device event and inject it as {{trigger.FIELD}} variables for subsequent actions. When remote_host is set the action queries the remote device via VAPIX; otherwise it reads from the local passive subscription cache.

remote_host.description: IP or hostname of a remote Axis device to query

remote_user.description: Username for the remote device (default: root)

remote_https.description: Reach the remote device over HTTPS (required for OS 13 HTTPS-only cameras). Self-signed certificate accepted.

delta.description: Amount to add (positive) or subtract (negative) from the counter

allOf.description: Run another rule's actions by ID. The target rule must be enabled and its conditions must pass.

rule_id.description: ID of the rule to trigger

allOf.description: Fire an ACAP event visible to other ACAP applications on this device.

event_id.description: ID of the declared ACAP event to fire (e.g. 'RuleFired', 'RuleError', 'EngineReady', or a custom event ID)

state.description: For stateful events only: true = High, false = Low. Omit for stateless (pulse) events.

data.description: For events declared with data fields: field name -> value. Values may contain templates and are converted to the field's declared type (string, int, double, bool). Empty or missing values send "" / 0 / false; a value that is not valid for its type fails the action.

message.description: Message to write to the system log. Supports {{variable}} substitution.

allOf.description: Pause the action sequence for N seconds before continuing.
Start or stop a configured PTZ guard tour.

tour_id.description: Guard tour ID or name (required when operation is start)

allOf.description: Update a camera parameter via param.cgi. The root. prefix is added automatically if omitted.
Capture a JPEG snapshot and POST or PUT it to a URL with Content-Type: image/jpeg.

headers.description: Extra request headers, one per line (Key: Value)

tls_profile.description: Name of a TLS profile (see /certs): private CA and/or client certificate for mutual TLS. Empty or absent: public CAs, no client certificate.

allOf.description: Force the IR cut filter to day or night mode, or restore automatic day/night switching.

mode.description: auto = camera decides; day = filter in (blocks IR); night = filter out (allows IR)

allOf.description: Enable or disable a named privacy mask.

mask_id.description: Privacy mask ID or name as configured on the camera

allOf.description: Trigger the camera clear view (wiper or speed dry) via clearviewcontrol.cgi. Requires AXIS OS 7.10+ and Properties.ClearView.ClearView=yes.

id.description: Clear View service ID from getServiceInfo: usually 0 = wiper, 1 = speed dry

duration.description: Duration in seconds. Only applicable for variable-duration wiper services. Omit to use device default.

allOf.description: Control an Axis illuminator (white light or IR LED).

operation.description: on = activateLight; off = deactivateLight; auto = setAutomaticIntensityMode; flash = strobe the light on/off one or more times, driven directly to bypass the firmware light-schedule 1s minimum. Note: the light must be enabled (hardware) before it can be activated.

light_id.description: Light device ID as reported by lightcontrol.cgi

intensity.description: Manual intensity (0–100). Only used when operation is on or flash. Omit to keep current intensity.

duration_ms.description: Per-pulse on-time in milliseconds. Only used when operation is flash. Clamped to 50–5000 ms.

gap_ms.description: Off-time between pulses in milliseconds. Only used when operation is flash and count > 1. Defaults to duration_ms. Clamped to 50–5000 ms.

count.description: Number of flash pulses. Only used when operation is flash. Clamped to 1–20.

allOf.description: Start, stop, or restart another installed ACAP application on this camera.
Show a text notification on an Axis speaker-display device, or stop an ongoing one. Uses the VAPIX Speaker Display Notification API (AXIS OS 11.11+).

operation.description: show: send a notification; stop: cancel the current notification.

message.description: Display message. Supports template variables. Required when operation is show.

scrollDirection.description: Scroll direction. Omit for static text (scrollSpeed 0).

duration_type.description: Duration mode. Omit for indefinite display.

duration_value.description: Number of repetitions, or milliseconds, depending on duration_type.

while_active.description: Only valid when duration_type is omitted. If true, automatically stops the display when the triggering condition clears.

allOf.description: Write one typed value or a block of values to Modbus holding registers or coils (TCP, serial gateway, or RTU/RS-485). Supports FC05/FC15 and FC06/FC16.

connection_type.description: Transport: tcp=Modbus TCP, serial_gateway=RTU framing via PortManager GenericTCPServer, rtu=direct serial

register.description: Single-value register address (0-based); use values for block writes

word_order.description: Byte order. All four apply to 32/64-bit values; for 16-bit values and strings only ABCD (normal) and BADC (bytes swapped in each register) differ

scale.description: Numeric input is converted to raw form using (value - offset) / scale; cannot be zero

length.description: String length in registers (2 bytes each); shorter text is padded as fill says

encoding.description: Character encoding of a string; characters it can't represent are rejected in literal values and sent as ? from templates

fill.description: String padding: nul puts the text first and fills with 0x00; space_* fill with spaces and put the text left, right or centered (an odd space goes after)

value.description: Single value to write; strings support template expansion. Required for numbers and coils; an empty string clears a text register. Coils accept 0/1, true/false, or on/off.

function.description: Write function; choose a coil function for coils and a register function for holding registers

values.description: Multiple typed values. Adjacent addresses are batched into one request of up to 123 registers (FC16) or 1968 coils (FC15); longer runs and long strings are split, and a gap starts another request. At most 32 requests per action.

value.description: Value to write; strings support template expansion.

allOf.description: Enable or disable another rule by ID.

rule_id.description: ID of the rule to enable or disable

allOf.description: Send an email. The SMTP server, sender, credentials and TLS options come from the smtp section of /settings; the action only carries the message.

to.description: Recipients, separated by commas or semicolons

attach_snapshot.description: Attach a JPEG snapshot (snapshot.jpg) and expose it as {{trigger.snapshot_base64}} in subject/body

allOf.description: POST a message ({"text": ...}) to a Slack incoming webhook.

webhook_url.description: Slack incoming webhook URL. Secret: replaced with __REDACTED__ in rule exports unless include_secrets=1.

attach_snapshot.description: Capture a JPEG snapshot and expose it as {{trigger.snapshot_base64}} for template expansion. No image is attached to the Slack message.

allOf.description: POST an Adaptive Card message to a Microsoft Teams Workflows / Power Automate webhook.

webhook_url.description: Teams webhook URL. Secret: replaced with __REDACTED__ in rule exports unless include_secrets=1.

attach_snapshot.description: Capture a JPEG snapshot and expose it as {{trigger.snapshot_base64}} for template expansion. No image is attached to the card.

allOf.description: Send a message through the Telegram Bot API (sendMessage, or sendPhoto with the message as caption when attach_snapshot is set).

bot_token.description: Telegram bot token. Secret: replaced with __REDACTED__ in rule exports unless include_secrets=1.

chat_id.description: Chat, group or channel ID. Must be a JSON string.

message.description: Message text (caption with a snapshot). Supports {{variable}} substitution.

parse_mode.description: Passed to Telegram unchanged when not empty (Markdown, MarkdownV2 or HTML)

attach_snapshot.description: Send a JPEG snapshot with the message as caption. Falls back to a text message if the snapshot cannot be captured.

allOf.description: Capture a JPEG snapshot (channel 1) and upload it with libcurl. Missing remote directories are created.

url.description: Destination URL including the file name (ftp://, ftps:// or sftp://). Supports {{variable}} substitution.

password.description: Secret: replaced with __REDACTED__ in rule exports unless include_secrets=1.

use_tls.description: Require explicit FTPS (AUTH TLS) on an ftp:// URL. ftps:// is always TLS.

tls_profile.description: Name of a TLS profile (see /certs): private CA and/or client certificate for mutual TLS. Empty or absent: public CAs, no client certificate.

allOf.description: Write one point in line protocol (measurement[,tags] fields) to InfluxDB. v2 posts to {url}/api/v2/write?org=&bucket= with an Authorization: Token header; v1 posts to {url}/write?db= with Basic auth (username / token).

version.description: InfluxDB API version. Empty means v2; any other value fails the action.

tags.description: Optional line-protocol tag set. Supports {{variable}} substitution.

username.description: v1: Basic auth user (auth is only sent when set)

token.description: v2: API token. v1: Basic auth password. Secret: replaced with __REDACTED__ in rule exports unless include_secrets=1.

tls_profile.description: Name of a TLS profile (see /certs): private CA and/or client certificate for mutual TLS. Empty or absent: public CAs, no client certificate.

allOf.description: Buffer one line per firing (up to 200; later lines are dropped) and send them together every interval seconds through another action type. The sent text is "[N events]" followed by the lines; it replaces message, body and payload. Add the target's own fields to this action (e.g. webhook_url, to/subject, topic/qos/retain, bot_token/chat_id). Edits to the delivery settings apply to the next delivery.

deliver_via.description: Delivered as slack_webhook, teams_webhook, email, mqtt_publish or telegram respectively

interval.description: Flush interval in seconds (values below 30 become 30)

allOf.description: Read AXIS Object Analytics accumulated crossline counts (getAccumulatedCounts) for a scenario on this device and add them to the trigger data for later actions: {{trigger.aoa_total}}, aoa_human, aoa_car, aoa_truck, aoa_bus, aoa_bike, aoa_otherVehicle and aoa_timestamp. remote_host is not supported.

reset_after.description: Reset the accumulated counts (resetAccumulatedCounts) after reading them

allOf.description: Execute a paging console action (POST /config/rest/paging-console-actions/v1/actions/{action_id}/execute). Supports remote_host.

action_id.description: Paging console action ID (letters, digits and hyphens only)

allOf.description: Assign a paging console action to a button slot on a page, or clear the slot (reads the page from /config/rest/paging-console-button-layout/v1/pages/{page_id}, updates actionLayout and writes it back). Supports remote_host.

page_id.description: Paging console page ID (letters, digits and hyphens only)

action_id.description: Action ID to assign (letters, digits and hyphens only). Empty or absent clears the slot.

is_counter.description: If true, this is a numeric counter rather than a string variable

latitude.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (North positive). Used as the default for Sunrise/Sunset schedule triggers.

alert_stream_enabled.description: Enable the Alert Stream endpoint. Missing from older saved settings is treated as enabled.

password.description: Write-only. Never returned in GET responses.

use_tls.description: Enable TLS for the broker connection.

tls_insecure.description: Skip broker certificate and hostname verification (e.g. self-signed certificates). Only applies when use_tls is true.

tls_profile.description: Name of a TLS profile (see /certs) with the broker's CA and/or a client certificate. Only applies when use_tls is true.

servers.description: Backup brokers as 'host' or 'host:port', tried in order when the primary is unreachable. A bare host reuses the primary port.

sparkplug.description: Sparkplug B edge node configuration. Uses the broker configured under 'mqtt', so MQTT must be enabled too.

spec_version.description: Only the host STATE topic and payload differ between the two.

edge_node_id.description: Defaults to the device serial number.

device_id.description: Optional. When set, metrics are published as a child device (DBIRTH/DDATA) instead of at node level.

primary_host_id.description: Optional. The node rebirths when this host announces itself online and buffers data while it reports itself offline.

metrics.description: Metric registry. The order fixes the aliases, so changing the list publishes a fresh birth certificate.

source.description: Optional device event to bind to. Present means the metric is published automatically whenever the event value changes; absent means it is driven by a Sparkplug B Publish rule action. GET /sparkplug returns this field alongside the derived read-only 'source_path', so a metric read from there can be written straight back.

source_key.description: Which field of the bound event payload to read.

gps.description: NMEA 0183 GPS input. A fix is considered stale after stale_after_s without a valid update.

device.description: Serial device path; auto resolves the camera's configured serial port.

baud.description: Serial baud rate; 0 preserves the camera's existing serial configuration.

host.description: Remote host for tcp_client. Listeners bind on all interfaces.

EventLogEntry.description: A rule entry (kind=rule) or a system message (kind=system).

get.summary: List all rules, fetch one by ID, or export all rules
get.description:
Without query parameters: returns all rules.

With `?id=UUID`: returns a single rule.

With `?action=export`: exports all rules as a JSON file download.

With `?id=UUID&action=export`: exports a single rule as JSON file.

Exports replace passwords, tokens, webhook URLs and credential header values with `__REDACTED__` unless `include_secrets=1` is given. `?id=UUID` without `action` returns the rule unchanged.

post.summary: Create/update a rule, bulk export, or bulk import rules
post.description:
Multiple modes:

**Create** (no parameters): POST a single rule object to create a new rule.

**Update** (`?id=UUID`): POST a single rule object to update existing rule with that ID.

**Export all** (`?action=export`): POST with optional empty body to export all rules as JSON array.

**Import** (`?action=import`): POST a **JSON array** of rule objects to bulk import them. Cannot import a single rule object — use the Create endpoint instead.

On create, update and import, a `__REDACTED__` value takes the stored value of the same rule (same `id`, same step type at the same position). Otherwise the field is removed and its path is listed in `missing_secrets`; a webhook trigger token is replaced with a new random token listed in `regenerated_tokens`. The create and import responses include these lists when they are not empty.

parameters.description: For create/update: if provided, updates the rule with this ID instead of creating new

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Operation: 'export' to get all rules as JSON array, 'import' to bulk import rules from a JSON array

parameters.description: With action=export: include passwords and tokens instead of __REDACTED__

post.summary: Create or update a TLS profile
post.description: PEM text for each part. An omitted part keeps the stored one, an empty string removes it. `cert` may also contain the chain and the private key. Encrypted keys need `passphrase`; the key is stored decrypted, readable only by the app. A profile needs a CA, a client certificate, or `insecure`. Saving a profile used by MQTT reconnects it.

name.description: Letters, digits, space, '-', '_' and '.', starting with a letter or digit

ca.description: CA certificate(s) the server certificate must chain to. Replaces the public CAs.

cert.description: Client certificate, optionally followed by its chain and private key

key.description: Private key matching the client certificate

insecure.description: Don't verify the server certificate (the client certificate is still sent)

400.description: Invalid name or certificate, key doesn't match the certificate, missing or wrong passphrase

409.description: The profile is used by rules or the MQTT settings, which are named in the message
